# Available variables: # - env: Odoo Environment on which the action is triggered # - model: Odoo Model of the record on which the action is triggered; is a void recordset # - record: record on which the action is triggered; may be void # - records: recordset of all records on which the action is triggered in multi-mode; may be void # - time, datetime, dateutil, timezone: useful Python libraries # - float_compare: Odoo function to compare floats based on specific precisions # - log: log(message, level='info'): logging function to record debug information in ir.logging table # - UserError: Warning Exception to use with raise # - Command: x2Many commands namespace # To return an action, assign: action = {...} for rec in records: user_timezone = timezone(env.user.tz or 'Europe/Istanbul') utc_timezone = timezone('UTC') today_local = datetime.datetime.now(user_timezone).date() local_start = user_timezone.localize(datetime.datetime.combine(today_local, datetime.time.min)) local_end = local_start + datetime.timedelta(days=1) utc_start = local_start.astimezone(utc_timezone).replace(tzinfo=None) utc_end = local_end.astimezone(utc_timezone).replace(tzinfo=None) if rec.user_role == "magaza": action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_window', 'name': 'Bugünün Vardiyaları', 'res_model': 'slots.profile', 'view_mode': 'kanban,tree,form', 'domain': [ '&','&','|',('magazalar.id', '=', rec.id),('partner_id.id', '=', rec.id),('start_date', '>=', utc_start),('start_date', '<', utc_end) ], 'target': 'current', # 'new' yeni bir pencere için 'context': { 'group_by': 'kurye' # 'kurye' alanına göre gruplama }, } if rec.user_role == "kurye": action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_window', 'name': 'Bugünün Vardiyaları', 'res_model': 'slots.profile', 'view_mode': 'kanban,tree,form', 'domain': [ '&','&',('skurye_profile_lines.partner_id.id', '=', rec.id),('start_date', '>=', utc_start),('start_date', '<', utc_end) ], 'target': 'current', # 'new' yeni bir pencere için 'context': { 'group_by': 'partner_id' # 'kurye' alanına göre gruplama }, }

# Available variables: # - env: Odoo Environment on which the action is triggered # - model: Odoo Model of the record on which the action is triggered; is a void recordset # - record: record on which the action is triggered; may be void # - records: recordset of all records on which the action is triggered in multi-mode; may be void # - time, datetime, dateutil, timezone: useful Python libraries # - float_compare: Odoo function to compare floats based on specific precisions # - log: log(message, level='info'): logging function to record debug information in ir.logging table # - UserError: Warning Exception to use with raise # - Command: x2Many commands namespace # To return an action, assign: action = {...} for rec in records: corders = env['corders.profile'].search(["&",["magaza.id","=",rec.partner_id.id],["kurye.id","=",rec.kurye.id],["siparis_tarihi",">=",rec.start_date],["siparis_tarihi","<=",rec.end_date]],limit=1) toplam_paket_ucreti = sum(corder.sale_price for corder in corders) toplam_odeme = toplam_paket_ucreti + rec.saat_araligi*rec.saatlik_ucret + rec.slot_promosyon_ucret log("Slot Id: " + str(rec.id) + " - " + str(rec.kurye.name) + " - Toplam Paket Ücreti: " + str(toplam_paket_ucreti) + " Saat Aralığı: " + str(rec.saat_araligi) + " Saatlik Ücret: " + str(rec.saatlik_ucret) + " Toplam Ödeme: " + str(toplam_odeme) + " Slot Promosyon Ücreti: " + str(rec.slot_promosyon_ucret), level='info') rec["sale_price"] = toplam_odeme
